description: Proof that retry count (invocation count) diverges from artifact INSERT count
card_requirement: Real call counts cannot be inferred from artifact INSERT alone

_correction.finding: REM-14 (P3), carried from the I-05-C review
_correction.defect: row 3 (previously `test_retry_count_vs_artifact_count_diverge`) reported retry_count=4 / artifact_insert_count=1, which belong to `test_invocation_trace_accuracy` (fail_count=3, max_retries=4 -> 3 failed + 1 success = 4 calls, 1 artifact). The named diverge test uses fail_count=2 -> 3 calls, 1 artifact.
_correction.resolution: the TEST code was correct and the RECORD was wrong, so the `test` field was corrected and the numbers were kept (changing the test to fit the record is forbidden by execution protocol step 6)

rows_reverified.row_1: test_llm_fails_first_succeeds_second: fail_count=1 -> 2 calls, 1 artifact -- attribution correct
rows_reverified.row_2: test_parser_fails_no_artifact: fail_count=999 max_retries=3 -> 3 calls, 0 artifacts -- attribution correct
rows_reverified.row_3: test_invocation_trace_accuracy: fail_count=3 max_retries=4 -> 4 calls, 1 artifact -- attribution CORRECTED
rows_reverified.not_listed_before: test_retry_count_vs_artifact_count_diverge: fail_count=2 -> 3 calls, 1 artifact (the divergence case the old row 3 was mislabelled as)

test_cases.scenario: LLM fails once, succeeds on retry
LLM fails 2 times, succeeds on 3rd (default max_retries)
test_cases._note: this row was ADDED so the test the old row 3 misnamed is also represented with its own true numbers

conclusion: InvocationTracker event log is the authoritative source for call counts, not artifact INSERTs
